column3: The Hebrew repeats the root for remaining in describing the remnant; BSB says “remnant who survived.”
The Hebrew coordinates the covenant and loving devotion; BSB says “His covenant of loving devotion.”
The Hebrew begins with an attentive ear in the singular and then open eyes; BSB begins with open eyes and uses ears in the plural.
The Hebrew emphasizes corrupt behavior by repeating the same root; BSB says “behaved corruptly.”
The Hebrew says the end of the heavens; BSB says the farthest horizon.
The Hebrew says “the prayer of Your servant” and “the prayer of Your servants”; BSB first says “my prayer” and then uses prayers in the plural.
